title: Coordinate basis conversion must include scale
environment: Tested semantic reconstruction in Blender 5.2.1. Previously saved scenes were not silently migrated; native geometry fidelity was not proved by these matrix checks.
goal: Convert semantic transform chains between coordinate systems.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Position and rotation were converted while scale remained in its original axis order.
what_worked: Historical correction: Change scale ordering consistently with the basis; leave native FBX handling separate. Verification reported by the source: Nonuniform, negative and zero-scale controls failed before correction and passed six local/world conjugation checks afterward. Fresh import plus save/reopen matched 271 semantic identities/parents and local bases within 1e-5.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Nonuniform real-input matrices differed; a three-node synthetic chain failed an independent matrix oracle.
why: Confirmed: under the tested basis mapping, diagonal scale required axis permutation while retaining signs.
improved_method: Test basis conversion using independent matrix conjugation and nonuniform, negative and zero scales. Uniform-scale examples cannot expose axis-order defects.
when_to_use: Tested semantic reconstruction in Blender 5.2.1. Previously saved scenes were not silently migrated; native geometry fidelity was not proved by these matrix checks.
when_not_to_use: Previously saved scenes were not silently migrated; native geometry fidelity was not proved by these matrix checks.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
